s1.syndrome_frame: A slowly progressive headache with a well-defined mass in the parietal bone
salient_findings: Mild headaches of several months’ duration
19-mm mass in the left parietal bone
Lesion isointense to muscle on T1-weighted images with multiple internal hyperintense foci
key_facts: Mild headaches of several months’ duration
Previous cranial MRI 4 years earlier showed no significant change in the lesion
Noncontrast CT of the head revealed a well-defined mass in the left parietal bone
MRI showed the lesion to be isointense to muscle on T1-weighted images
Lesion had multiple internal hyperintense foci on T1-weighted images
Lesion had heterogeneous signal on T2-weighted images

shortlist.label: Intraosseous metaplastic meningioma
shortlist.why_kept: Confirmed by identifying ossification and lipomatous tissue

shortlist.label: Osseous hemangioma
shortlist.why_kept: Considered due to preserved trabecular architecture and lack of destruction of pre-existing structures

shortlist.label: Hyperplastic bone marrow
shortlist.why_kept: Considered due to T1 hyperintense foci, but less likely due to other characteristics

shortlist.label: Paget disease of bone
shortlist.why_kept: Considered but less likely due to atypical presentation

shortlist.label: Osteoma
shortlist.why_kept: Possible due to well-defined mass in the parietal bone with sparse but preserved trabeculae

raw.rationale: The lesion's characteristics, such as being isointense to muscle on T1-weighted images, having multiple internal hyperintense foci, and having restricted diffusion, along with the presence of a well-defined mass in the left parietal bone and no significant change in size over 4 years, are consistent with intraosseous metaplastic meningioma

rejected.label: Osseous hemangioma
rejected.why: While considered, the lack of destruction of pre-existing structures and specific imaging characteristics make it less likely

rejected.label: Hyperplastic bone marrow
rejected.why: Excluded due to specific characteristics of the lesion not matching hyperplastic bone marrow

rejected.label: Paget disease of bone
rejected.why: Excluded due to atypical presentation and imaging characteristics not consistent with Paget disease

rejected.label: Osteoma
rejected.why: Not considered a strong candidate due to the lesion's complex imaging characteristics and lack of typical osteoma features
